app/auth.py\n\"\"\"Sessions, CSRF tokens, and the signed-in user.\n\nThe session lives in a signed cookie (Starlette's SessionMiddleware). It holds\nonly the user id and the CSRF token, never a password.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport hmac\nimport secrets\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, Request\n\nfrom app import users\n\n\nclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised for an anonymous visitor; main.py turns it into a redirect.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Return this session's CSRF token, creating one if needed.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not token:\n        token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n        request.session[\"csrf_token\"] = token\n    return token\n\n\nasync def check_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for every state-changing route: reject a missing or wrong token.\"\"\"\n    form = await request.form()\n    sent = form.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not (isinstance(sent, str) and expected\n            and hmac.compare_digest(sent, expected)):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"Invalid or missing CSRF token\")\n\n\ndef current_user(request: Request) -> sqlite3.Row:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for every admin screen: the signed-in, still-active user.\"\"\"\n    user_id = request.session.get(\"user_id\")\n    user = users.get_active_user(user_id) if user_id else None\n    if user is None:\n        request.session.pop(\"user_id\", None)\n        raise LoginRequired\n    return user\n\n\ndef start_session(request: Request, user: sqlite3.Row) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Begin a fresh session for the user, with a new CSRF token.\"\"\"\n    request.session.clear()\n    request.session[\"user_id\"] = user[\"id\"]\n    csrf_token(request)\n\n\ndef end_session(request: Request) -> None:\n    request.session.clear()\n\n\nCSRF = Depends(check_csrf)\nSIGNED_IN = Depends(current_user)\n=== app/db.py\n\"\"\"SQLite access. Every call opens a short-lived connection to the current\nsettings.DATABASE_PATH, so tests can point it at a temporary file.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom contextlib import contextmanager\nfrom collections.abc import Iterator\n\nfrom app import settings\n\nSCHEMA = \"\"\"\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (\n    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    email         TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n    name          TEXT NOT NULL,\n    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,\n    role          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'editor')),\n    active        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\"\"\"\n\n\n@contextmanager\ndef connect() -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:\n    \"\"\"Yield a connection with the schema in place; commit on success.\"\"\"\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(settings.DATABASE_PATH)\n    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    try:\n        conn.executescript(SCHEMA)\n        yield conn\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n=== app/templating.py\n\"\"\"The Jinja environment shared by the admin console routes.\n\nEvery admin template gets `csrf_token`, so each state-changing form can carry\nit without each route passing it by hand.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import auth, settings\n\n\ndef _csrf(request: Request) -> dict[str, str]:\n    return {\"csrf_token\": auth.csrf_token(request)}\n\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES), context_processors=[_csrf])\n=== app/users.py\n\"\"\"Users: argon2 password hashing, lookup, and the demo seed.\n\nA plain password only ever passes through these functions on its way to\nargon2. It is never stored, returned, or logged.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom argon2 import PasswordHasher\nfrom argon2.exceptions import InvalidHashError, VerificationError\n\nfrom app import db\n\n_hasher = PasswordHasher()\n# Verified against when the email is unknown, so a miss costs the same time\n# as a wrong password and does not reveal which emails exist.\n_DUMMY_HASH = _hasher.hash(\"no-such-user\")\n\nDEMO_ADMIN = {\"email\": \"admin@example.test\", \"name\": \"Sample Admin\"}\nDEMO_EDITOR = {\"email\": \"editor@example.test\", \"name\": \"Sample Editor\"}\n\n\ndef create_user(email: str, name: str, password: str, role: str) -> int:\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        cursor = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO users (email, name, password_hash, role) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (email.strip(), name, _hasher.hash(password), role),\n        )\n        return cursor.lastrowid\n\n\ndef set_active(user_id: int, active: bool) -> None:\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE users SET active = ? WHERE id = ?\", (int(active), user_id))\n\n\ndef get_active_user(user_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT id, email, name, role FROM users WHERE id = ? AND active = 1\",\n            (user_id,),\n        ).fetchone()\n\n\ndef authenticate(email: str, password: str) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the active user with this email and password, else None.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        user = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT id, email, name, role, active, password_hash FROM users \"\n            \"WHERE email = ?\",\n            (email.strip(),),\n        ).fetchone()\n    try:\n        _hasher.verify(user[\"password_hash\"] if user else _DUMMY_HASH, password)\n    except (VerificationError, InvalidHashError):\n        return None\n    if not user or not user[\"active\"]:\n        return None\n    return user\n\n\ndef seed_demo_users(admin_password: str, editor_password: str) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Create the demo admin and editor if missing. Return the emails created.\"\"\"\n    created = []\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        existing = {row[\"email\"].lower() for row in conn.execute(\"SELECT email FROM users\")}\n    for person, password, role in ((DEMO_ADMIN, admin_password, \"admin\"),\n                                   (DEMO_EDITOR, editor_password, \"editor\")):\n        if person[\"email\"] not in existing:\n            create_user(person[\"email\"], person[\"name\"], password, role)\n            created.append(person[\"email\"])\n    return created\n=== app/main.py\n\"\"\"The FastAPI application.\n\nThe admin console answers at /admin (behind login) and the public preview at /.\nRoutes live in their own modules under app/routes/ and are included here. Keep\nthis file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import FastAPI, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import auth, settings\nfrom app.routes import admin, login\nfrom app.templating import templates\n\n\ndef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\")\n    app.add_middleware(SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n                       session_cookie=\"cms_session\", same_site=\"strict\")\n\n    @app.exception_handler(auth.LoginRequired)\n    def send_to_login(request: Request, exc: auth.LoginRequired):\n        return RedirectResponse(\"/login\", status_code=303)\n\n    app.include_router(login.router)\n    app.include_router(admin.router)\n\n    @app.get(\"/\")\n    def public_home(request: Request):\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"public/home.html\",\n            {\"title\": settings.SITE_TITLE, \"items\": []},\n        )\n\n    return app\n\n\napp = create_app()\n=== app/settings.py\n\"\"\"Configuration, read from the environment (never hard-code secrets).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport secrets\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nTEMPLATES = ROOT / \"templates\"\nSITE = ROOT / \"site\"\n\n# Signs the session cookie. Without CMS_SECRET_KEY a random per-process key is\n# used: sessions end on restart, but nobody can forge one from a known default.\nSECRET_KEY = os.environ.get(\"CMS_SECRET_KEY\") or secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\nDATABASE_PATH = Path(os.environ.get(\"CMS_DATABASE\", ROOT / \"cms.db\"))\nSITE_TITLE = os.environ.get(\"CMS_SITE_TITLE\", \"My CMS\")\n# Set this to your Pages URL once you deploy, e.g.\n# https://yourname.github.io/iphs400-mp2-cms/\nBASE_PATH = os.environ.get(\"CMS_BASE_PATH\", \"\")\n=== app/publish.py\n\"\"\"Render the public site into site/ as plain HTML.\n\nT00 publishes a placeholder home page. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"posts/x.html\"), never\n     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport shutil\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n\nfrom app import settings\n\nCSS = \"\"\"/* Minimal starter styles — make them yours. */\n:root { color-scheme: light dark; }\nbody { font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 42rem; padding: 1rem; }\nheader a { font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }\nmain { margin-block: 2rem; }\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef environment() -> Environment:\n    return Environment(\n        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n    )\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    env = environment()\n    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(CSS)\n    (out / \"index.html\").write_text(\n        env.get_template(\"public/home.html\").render(\n            title=settings.SITE_TITLE, items=[], css_path=\"style.css\",\n            home_path=\"index.html\",\n        )\n    )\n    return out\n=== app/routes/admin.py\n\"\"\"The admin console home. These pass in the fresh template.\n\nDo not delete them. If a change breaks them, the change broke the app's front\ndoor.\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef test_admin_console_answers(client_as):\n    # T01 put the console behind login, so the front door is checked signed in.\n    response = client_as(\"admin\").get(\"/admin\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"hello admin\" in response.text.lower()\n\n\ndef test_public_home_answers(client):\n    response = client.get(\"/\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n\n\ndef test_publish_writes_a_site(tmp_path):\n    from app.publish import render_site\n\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    assert (out / \"index.html\").exists() and (out / \"style.css\").exists()\n\n\ndef test_published_html_uses_relative_paths(tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"Root-absolute paths break on GitHub Pages project URLs (rubric F2).\"\"\"\n    from app.publish import render_site\n\n    html = (render_site(tmp_path / \"site\") / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert 'href=\"/' not in html and 'src=\"/' not in html\n{% extends \"base.html\" %}\n{% block content %}\n  <h1>{{ title }}</h1>\n  {% if items %}\n    <ul>{% for item in items %}<li><a href=\"{{ item.href }}\">{{ item.title }}</a></li>{% endfor %}</ul>\n  {% else %}\n    <p>Nothing published yet.</p>\n  {% endif %}\n{% endblock %}\n# Security checklist\n\nWhat must be true before you submit. *How* to make each one true is your work —\nthat is the point of the tickets.\n\n| # | Must be true | How the grader checks it |\n|---|---|---|\n| 1 | Stored passwords are argon2 hashes | Reads the seeded database and looks at the stored value |\n| 2 | Wrong passwords are refused, and the message does not reveal whether the account exists | Tries a bad password |\n| 3 | Every state-changing form (POST) carries a CSRF token and rejects a request without one | Replays each POST with the token removed |\n| 4 | An editor cannot reach any admin-only route | Logs in as the seeded editor and requests each admin route |\n| 5 | An anonymous visitor is redirected to login, never shown admin content | Requests admin routes with no session |\n| 6 | A deactivated user cannot log in | Deactivates the seeded editor, then tries to log in |\n| 7 | User-written Markdown cannot inject scripts | Saves a post containing `<script>` and an `onerror=` attribute, publishes, and checks both the preview and the export |\n| 8 | Drafts never appear in `site/` or on the public site | Publishes with a draft present and searches the output |\n| 9 | No secrets, databases, or `.env` files in git history | Greps the full history |\n| 10 | Access control is enforced in code, not by hiding links | Requests admin URLs directly rather than clicking |\n\nRule of thumb: if the only thing stopping an editor from reaching a page is that\nthe link is hidden, it is not stopping anyone.\ndocs:\nadr\nagents\nhandoff\nmanual_iphs400_mp2-web-cms_20260922.md\nmp2-grading-rubric_20260922.md\nmp2-setup_context-threshold-hook_20260922.md\nprocess\nscreenshots\ntech-spec_web-cms_v1_sonnet5med_20261012.md\ntranscripts\n\ndocs/adr:\nADR-001-local-admin-static-public.md\nADR-002-stack.md\n\ndocs/screenshots:\nt01_login-and-admin_390px.png\n#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Create demo data so a grader (and you) can use the CMS immediately.\n\n    uv run --env-file .env python scripts/seed_demo.py\n\nIt creates one admin and one editor (passwords read from the environment, never\nhard-coded). Later tickets extend it with sample updates and pages, at least one\ndraft and one published. Running it twice is harmless: existing users are kept.\n\nThe rubric expects this to run clean on a fresh clone with .env.example values\n(item E4), because the database itself is never committed.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nsys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))\n\nfrom app import settings  # noqa: E402\nfrom app.users import DEMO_ADMIN, DEMO_EDITOR, seed_demo_users  # noqa: E402\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    admin_pw = os.environ.get(\"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD\")\n    editor_pw = os.environ.get(\"CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD\")\n    if not admin_pw or not editor_pw:\n        print(\"Set CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD and CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD in .env \"\n              \"(copy .env.example).\")\n        return 1\n\n    created = seed_demo_users(admin_pw, editor_pw)\n    for person in (DEMO_ADMIN, DEMO_EDITOR):\n        state = \"created\" if person[\"email\"] in created else \"already exists\"\n        print(f\"{person['email']}: {state}\")\n    print(f\"Database: {settings.DATABASE_PATH}\")\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(main())","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"89385976-a8e8-4564-ae14-5eda0ae1b0df","timestamp":"2026-10-12T22:51:10.031Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"\"\"\"T00: the walking skeleton. As an editor, I want a success or error message after every save, so that I know whether my change landed.\n65:- **Vocabulary.** All code, templates, and tickets use the terms in `CONTEXT.md`: Update (stored as a post), Fixture, Match report, Page, Nav order, Draft, Published, Slug, Admin, Editor, Hand-over, Last updated.\n68:- **Content.** Updates and Pages share the same core fields: title, slug, Markdown body, status (draft or published), author, created and updated timestamps. Pages add a nav order. Only two statuses exist.\n69:- **Slugs.** Generated from the title on first save, made unique automatically, and not editable by editors. Only the admin may change a slug.\n70:- **Permissions.** Editor: create content as drafts, edit any draft, delete own drafts, view the content list and dashboard. Editor may not publish, unpublish, edit or delete published content, delete another editor's draft, or reach user management. Admin: everything, including publish, unpublish, edit and delete published content, and user management. Admin-only routes return 403 for editors and redirect anonymous visitors to login.\n71:- **Session and login.** Cookie-based sessions. Login failures show one generic message. Deactivated users cannot log in.\n73:- **Markdown safety.** User Markdown is rendered and then sanitized with an allow-list, both in the admin preview and in the export, so script tags and event-handler attributes never execute.\n74:- **Admin console.** A dashboard with counts, a filterable content list (by status and by type), an editor with a Markdown preview, a user list, and persistent navigation. Every save shows a success or error message. The console is not themed beyond clear, plain styling.\n83:- **Seam 1: the HTTP app.** Every capability is tested through the FastAPI test client, using the existing `client` and `client_as(role)` helpers. This covers login and logout, roles and the editor 403 and anonymous redirect on every admin-only route, content CRUD and status changes, the dashboard and filters, preview, user management, hand-over, CSRF rejection, and sanitized preview output.\n102:- **Core ticket plan.** The 7 required capabilities should split into 7 to 9 vertical tickets, each demoable alone and touching data, route, template, and test.\n# ADR-002: FastAPI + Jinja + SQLite, with no frontend framework\n\n**Status:** accepted (set by the assignment)\n**Date:** 2026-09-22\n\n## Context\n\nThe project has to be readable by someone who has never built a web application,\ngradable from a clean clone, and finishable in two weeks on a $20 plan. Options\nconsidered: Django (batteries included, but a large amount of generated code to\nread), Flask (similar to FastAPI here), a JavaScript stack (a second language and\na build step), and FastAPI with server-rendered templates.\n\n## Decision\n\nFastAPI with Jinja2 templates, SQLite for storage, argon2 for password hashing,\nand an HTML sanitizer for user Markdown. No frontend framework, no build step.\n\n## Consequences\n\n- Every page is server-rendered, so \"view source\" shows what the code produced,\n  which makes debugging visible.\n- SQLite is a single file, so a grader can seed and inspect it easily. It is\n  gitignored; `scripts/seed_demo.py` rebuilds it.\n- No build step means the file you preview is the file that ships.\n- Interactive flourishes (live preview without reload, drag-and-drop) cost more\n  here than in a JavaScript stack. admin writes update drafts (issue #3).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app.main import create_app\nfrom conftest import DEMO_USERS, csrf_token, login\n\nNEW = \"/admin/updates/new\"\nEDIT_LINK = re.compile(r'/admin/updates/(\\d+)')\n\n\ndef save_new(client: TestClient, title: str, body: str = \"\", **extra):\n    data = {\"title\": title, \"body\": body, \"csrf_token\": csrf_token(client, NEW), **extra}\n    return client.post(\"/admin/updates\", data=data, follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef create(client: TestClient, title: str, body: str = \"\") -> str:\n    \"\"\"Save a new update and return its edit URL.\"\"\"\n    response = save_new(client, title, body)\n    assert response.status_code == 303, response.text\n    return response.headers[\"location\"]\n\n\ndef save_edit(client: TestClient, url: str, title: str, body: str = \"\", **extra):\n    data = {\"title\": title, \"body\": body, \"csrf_token\": csrf_token(client, url), **extra}\n    return client.post(url, data=data, follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef test_admin_creates_a_draft_with_author_and_timestamps(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    url = create(admin, \"Lords beat Denison\", \"A **good** night.\")\n\n    page = admin.get(url)\n    assert page.status_code == 200\n    assert 'value=\"Lords beat Denison\"' in page.text\n    assert \"Draft\" in page.text\n    assert \"Sample Admin\" in page.text\n    assert re.search(r\"Created\\s*<time[^>]*>\\d{4}-\\d\\d-\\d\\d\", page.text)\n    assert re.search(r\"Updated\\s*<time[^>]*>\\d{4}-\\d\\d-\\d\\d\", page.text)\n\n    listing = admin.get(\"/admin/updates\").text\n    assert \"Lords beat Denison\" in listing and \"Draft\" in listing\n\n\ndef test_new_updates_are_drafts_even_if_the_form_says_published(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    url = create(admin, \"Sneaky\", \"\")\n    save_edit(admin, url, \"Sneaky\", \"\", status=\"published\")\n    assert \"Draft\" in admin.get(url).text\n    assert \"Published\" not in admin.get(url).text\n\n\ndef test_slug_comes_from_title_and_stays_unique(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    first = admin.get(create(admin, \"Lords Beat Denison 2–1!\")).text\n    second = admin.get(create(admin, \"Lords Beat Denison 2–1!\")).text\n    slugs = [re.search(r'data-slug=\"([^\"]+)\"', page).group(1) for page in (first, second)]\n    assert slugs[0] == \"lords-beat-denison-2-1\"\n    assert slugs[1] != slugs[0] and slugs[1].startswith(\"lords-beat-denison-2-1\")\n\n\ndef test_slug_does_not_change_when_the_title_is_edited(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    url = create(admin, \"Original title\")\n    save_edit(admin, url, \"A new title\")\n    page = admin.get(url).text\n    assert 'value=\"A new title\"' in page\n    assert 'data-slug=\"original-title\"' in page\n\n\ndef test_an_edit_persists_across_a_server_restart(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    url = create(admin, \"Before\", \"old body\")\n    assert save_edit(admin, url, \"After\", \"new body\").status_code == 303\n\n    restarted = TestClient(create_app())\n    login(restarted, DEMO_USERS[\"admin\"][\"email\"], DEMO_USERS[\"admin\"][\"password\"])\n    page = restarted.get(url).text\n    assert 'value=\"After\"' in page and \"new body\" in page\n\n\ndef test_editor_shows_a_markdown_preview(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    url = create(admin, \"Preview me\", \"Some **bold** words\")\n    assert \"<strong>bold</strong>\" in admin.get(url).text\n\n\ndef test_preview_button_renders_without_saving(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    response = save_new(admin, \"Not yet\", \"# Heading\", action=\"preview\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"<h1>Heading</h1>\" in response.text\n    assert \"Not yet\" not in admin.get(\"/admin/updates\").text\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"body\", [\n    \"<script>alert(1)</script>\",\n    '<img src=\"x\" onerror=\"alert(1)\">',\n    \"[click](javascript:alert(1))\",\n])\ndef test_preview_is_sanitized(client_as, body):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    for page in (save_new(admin, \"XSS\", body, action=\"preview\").text,\n                 admin.get(create(admin, \"XSS\", body)).text):\n        preview = page.split('class=\"preview\"', 1)[1]\n        assert \"<script\" not in preview\n        assert \"onerror\" not in preview\n        assert \"javascript:\" not in preview\n\n\ndef test_good_save_shows_a_success_message(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    page = admin.get(create(admin, \"Saved\")).text\n    assert 'class=\"success\"' in page and \"saved\" in test_empty_title_shows_an_error_and_saves_nothing(client_as, title):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    response = save_new(admin, title, \"body kept\")\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert 'class=\"error\"' in response.text and \"title\" in response.text.lower()\n    assert \"body kept\" in response.text\n    assert \"body kept\" not in admin.get(\"/admin/updates\").text\n\n\ndef test_empty_title_on_edit_shows_an_error_and_keeps_the_old_one(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    url = create(admin, \"Keep me\")\n (\"get\", \"/admin/updates\"), (\"get\", NEW), (\"get\", \"/admin/updates/1\"),\n    (\"post\", \"/admin/updates\"), (\"post\", \"/admin/updates/1\"),\n])\ndef admin writes update drafts (issue #3).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app.main import create_app\nfrom conftest import DEMO_USERS, csrf_token, login\n\nNEW = \"/admin/updates/new\"\nEDIT_LINK = re.compile(r'/admin/updates/(\\d+)')\n\n\ndef save_new(client: TestClient, title: str, body: str = \"\", **extra):\n    data = {\"title\": title, \"body\": body, \"csrf_token\": csrf_token(client, NEW), **extra}\n    return client.post(\"/admin/updates\", data=data, follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef create(client: TestClient, title: str, body: str = \"\") -> str:\n    \"\"\"Save a new update and return its edit URL.\"\"\"\n    response = save_new(client, title, body)\n    assert response.status_code == 303, response.text\n    return response.headers[\"location\"]\n\n\ndef save_edit(client: TestClient, url: str, title: str, body: str = \"\", **extra):\n    data = {\"title\": title, \"body\": body, \"csrf_token\": csrf_token(client, url), **extra}\n    return client.post(url, data=data, follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef test_admin_creates_a_draft_with_author_and_timestamps(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    url = create(admin, \"Lords beat Denison\", \"A **good** night.\")\n\n    page = admin.get(url)\n    assert page.status_code == 200\n    assert 'value=\"Lords beat Denison\"' in page.text\n    assert \"Draft\" in page.text\n    assert \"Sample Admin\" in page.text\n    assert re.search(r\"Created\\s*<time[^>]*>\\d{4}-\\d\\d-\\d\\d\", page.text)\n    assert re.search(r\"Updated\\s*<time[^>]*>\\d{4}-\\d\\d-\\d\\d\", page.text)\n\n    listing = admin.get(\"/admin/updates\").text\n    assert \"Lords beat Denison\" in listing and \"Draft\" in listing\n\n\ndef test_new_updates_are_drafts_even_if_the_form_says_published(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    url = create(admin, \"Sneaky\", \"\")\n    save_edit(admin, url, \"Sneaky\", \"\", status=\"published\")\n    assert \"Draft\" in admin.get(url).text\n    assert \"Published\" not in admin.get(url).text\n\n\ndef test_slug_comes_from_title_and_stays_unique(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    first = admin.get(create(admin, \"Lords Beat Denison 2–1!\")).text\n    second = admin.get(create(admin, \"Lords Beat Denison 2–1!\")).text\n    slugs = [re.search(r'data-slug=\"([^\"]+)\"', page).group(1) for page in (first, second)]\n    assert slugs[0] == \"lords-beat-denison-2-1\"\n    assert slugs[1] != slugs[0] and slugs[1].startswith(\"lords-beat-denison-2-1\")\n\n\ndef test_slug_does_not_change_when_the_title_is_edited(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    url = create(admin, \"Original title\")\n    save_edit(admin, url, \"A new title\")\n    page = admin.get(url).text\n    assert 'value=\"A new title\"' in page\n    assert 'data-slug=\"original-title\"' in page\n\n\ndef test_an_edit_persists_across_a_server_restart(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    url = create(admin, \"Before\", \"old body\")\n    assert save_edit(admin, url, \"After\", \"new body\").status_code == 303\n\n    restarted = TestClient(create_app())\n    login(restarted, DEMO_USERS[\"admin\"][\"email\"], DEMO_USERS[\"admin\"][\"password\"])\n    page = restarted.get(url).text\n    assert 'value=\"After\"' in page and \"new body\" in page\n\n\ndef test_editor_shows_a_markdown_preview(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    url = create(admin, \"Preview me\", \"Some **bold** words\")\n    assert \"<strong>bold</strong>\" in admin.get(url).text\n\n\ndef test_preview_button_renders_without_saving(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    response = save_new(admin, \"Not yet\", \"# Heading\", action=\"preview\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"<h1>Heading</h1>\" in response.text\n    assert \"Not yet\" not in admin.get(\"/admin/updates\").text\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"body\", [\n    \"<script>alert(1)</script>\",\n    '<img src=\"x\" onerror=\"alert(1)\">',\n    \"[click](javascript:alert(1))\",\n])\ndef test_preview_is_sanitized(client_as, body):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    for page in (save_new(admin, \"XSS\", body, action=\"preview\").text,\n                 admin.get(create(admin, \"XSS\", body)).text):\n        preview = page.split('class=\"preview\"', 1)[1]\n        assert \"<script\" not in preview\n        assert \"onerror\" not in preview\n        assert \"javascript:\" not in preview\n\n\ndef test_good_save_shows_a_success_message(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    page = admin.get(create(admin, \"Saved\")).text\n    assert 'class=\"success\"' in page and \"saved\" in page.lower()\n    assert 'class=\"success\"' not in admin.get(\"/admin/updates\").text  # shown once\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"title\", [\"\", \"   \"])\ndef test_empty_title_shows_an_error_and_saves_nothing(client_as, title):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    response = save_new(admin, title, \"body kept\")\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert 'class=\"error\"' in response.text and \"title\" in response.text.lower()\n    assert \"body kept\" in response.text\n    assert \"body kept\" not in admin.get(\"/admin/updates\").text\n\n\ndef test_empty_title_on_edit_shows_an_error_and_keeps_the_old_one(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    url = create(admin, \"Keep me\")\n    response = save_edit(admin, url, \"\")\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert 'class=\"error\"' in response.text\n    assert 'value=\"Keep me\"' in admin.get(url).text\n\n\ndef test_unknown_update_is_not_found(client_as):\n    assert client_as(\"admin\").get(\"/admin/updates/999\").status_code == 404\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"path\", [\"/admin\", \"/admin/updates\", NEW])\ndef test_admin_navigation_is_on_every_admin_screen(client_as, path):\n    page = client_as(\"admin\").get(path).text\n    nav = page.split(\"<nav\", 1)[1].split(\"</nav>\", 1)[0]\n    assert 'href=\"/admin\"' in nav\n    assert 'href=\"/admin/updates\"' in nav\n    assert f'href=\"{NEW}\"' in nav\n    assert 'action=\"/logout\"' in nav\n\n\ndef test_navigation_is_on_the_edit_screen(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    assert 'href=\"/admin/updates\"' in admin.get(create(admin, \"Nav check\")).text\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"token\", [None, \"forged-token\"])\ndef test_saving_without_a_valid_csrf_token_is_rejected(client_as, token):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    url = create(admin, \"Guarded\")\n    admin.get(NEW)\n    for path in (\"/admin/updates\", url):\n        data = {\"title\": \"Forged\", \"body\": \"\"}\n        if token:\n            data[\"csrf_token\"] = token\n        assert admin.post(path, data=data, follow_redirects=False).status_code == 403\n    assert \"Forged\" not in admin.get(\"/admin/updates\").text\n\n\ndef test_every_form_on_the_editor_carries_a_csrf_token(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    for path in (NEW, create(admin, \"Forms\")):\n        page = admin.get(path).text\n        forms = re.findall(r\"<form.*?</form>\", page, re.S)\n        assert forms\n        for form in forms:\n            assert 'name=\"csrf_token\"' in form\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"method,path\", [\n    (\"get\", \"/admin/updates\"), (\"get\", NEW), (\"get\", \"/admin/updates/1\"),\n    (\"post\", \"/admin/updates\"), (\"post\", \"/admin/updates/1\"),\n])\ndef test_anonymous_visitor_is_sent_to_login(client, method, path):\n    response = getattr(client, method)(path, follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert response.headers[\"location\"].endswith(\"/login\")\n\n\ndef test_editor_screen_sets_a_mobile_viewport(client_as):\n    \"\"\"390 px fit is checked by hand with a screenshot; this guards the basics.\"\"\"\n    page = client_as(\"admin\").get(NEW).text\n    assert 'name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1\"' in The slug is made from the title on first save,\nkept unique, and never changed by an edit.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nimport unicodedata\nfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\n\nfrom app import db\n\n\nclass InvalidUpdate(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"The form cannot be saved; the message is shown to the user.\"\"\"\n\n\n_SELECT = (\n    \"SELECT posts.id, title, slug, body, status, created_at, updated_at, \"\n    \"users.name AS author FROM posts JOIN users ON users.id = posts.author_id\"\n)\n\n\ndef slugify(title: str) -> str:\n    ascii_title = unicodedata.normalize(\"NFKD\", title).encode(\"ascii\", \"ignore\").decode()\n    return re.sub(r\"[^a-z0-9]+\", \"-\", ascii_title.lower()).strip(\"-\") or \"update\"\n\n\ndef _unique_slug(conn: sqlite3.Connection, title: str) -> str:\n    base = slugify(title)\n    taken = {row[\"slug\"] for row in conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT slug FROM posts WHERE slug = ? OR slug LIKE ?\", (base, f\"{base}-%\"))}\n    slug, n = base, 2\n    while slug in taken:\n        slug, n = f\"{base}-{n}\", n + 1\n    return slug\n\n\ndef _now() -> str:\n    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec=\"seconds\")\n\n\ndef _clean_title(title: str) -> str:\n    title = title.strip()\n    if not title:\n        raise InvalidUpdate(\"The title cannot be empty.\")\n    return title\n\n\ndef create_update(title: str, body: str, author_id: int) -> int:\n    title = _clean_title(title)\n    now = _now()\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        cursor = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO posts (title, slug, body, status, author_id, created_at, updated_at) \"\n            \"VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'draft', ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (title, _unique_slug(conn, title), body, author_id, now, now),\n        )\n        return cursor.lastrowid\n\n\ndef edit_update(update_id: int, title: str, body: str) -> None:\n    title = _clean_title(title)\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE posts SET title = ?, body = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?\",\n            (title, body, _now(), update_id),\n        )\n\n\ndef get_update(update_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        return conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE posts.id = ?\", (update_id,)).fetchone()\n\n\ndef list_updates() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        return conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} ORDER BY updated_at DESC, posts.id DESC\").fetchall()\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":558,"cache_read_input_tokens":52541,"output_tokens":1900,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":558,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":1900,"cache_read_input_tokens":52541,"cache_creation_input_tokens":558,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":558},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01KucwidHMvMdbtrKDRao4g1":{"file_path":"/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/updates.py","content":"\"\"\"Updates: team news items, stored as posts.\n\nNew updates are always drafts. The slug is made from the title on first save,\nkept unique, and never changed by an edit.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nimport unicodedata\nfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\n\nfrom app import db\n\n\nclass InvalidUpdate(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"The form cannot be saved; the message is shown to the user.\"\"\"\n\n\n_SELECT = (\n    \"SELECT posts.id, title, slug, body, status, created_at, updated_at, \"\n    \"users.name AS author FROM posts JOIN users ON users.id = posts.author_id\"\n)\n\n\ndef slugify(title: str) -> str:\n    ascii_title = unicodedata.normalize(\"NFKD\", title).encode(\"ascii\", \"ignore\").decode()\n    return re.sub(r\"[^a-z0-9]+\", \"-\", ascii_title.lower()).strip(\"-\") or \"update\"\n\n\ndef _unique_slug(conn: sqlite3.Connection, title: str) -> str:\n    base = slugify(title)\n    taken = {row[\"slug\"] for row in conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT slug FROM posts WHERE slug = ? OR slug LIKE ?\", (base, f\"{base}-%\"))}\n    slug, n = base, 2\n    while slug in taken:\n        slug, n = f\"{base}-{n}\", n + 1\n    return slug\n\n\ndef _now() -> str:\n    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec=\"seconds\")\n\n\ndef _clean_title(title: str) -> str:\n    title = title.strip()\n    if not title:\n        raise InvalidUpdate(\"The title cannot be empty.\")\n    return title\n\n\ndef create_update(title: str, body: str, author_id: int) -> int:\n    title = _clean_title(title)\n    now = _now()\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        cursor = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO posts (title, slug, body, status, author_id, created_at, updated_at) \"\n            \"VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'draft', ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (title, _unique_slug(conn, title), body, author_id, now, now),\n        )\n        return cursor.lastrowid\n\n\ndef edit_update(update_id: int, title: str, body: str) -> None:\n    title = _clean_title(title)\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE posts SET title = ?, body = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?\",\n            (title, body, _now(), update_id),\n        )\n\n\ndef get_update(update_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        return conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE posts.id = ?\", (update_id,)).fetchone()\n\n\ndef list_updates() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        return conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} ORDER BY updated_at DESC, posts.id DESC\").fetchall()\n"}},"serverClassifierRequest":"0e08604c-cb97-4fb6-a590-c22c452f6a5c","apiBlockIndex":3,"requestId":"req_011CfyAQiKT17Argr7hREVNT","requestedModel":"claude-opus-5-5","attributionSkill":"mattpocock-skills:implement","attributionPlugin":"mattpocock-skills","type":"assistant","uuid":"7d54be4f-6a1d-413d-a9e2-a9a620d534c3","timestamp":"2026-10-12T22:52:19.474Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"medium","perTurnEffort":"medium","session_id":"a121db57-1bee-4dbb-8856-8744e70c4142","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"6246237e-54ea-46c9-98d8-12c1c8982686","version":"2.1.296","gitBranch":"main"}

The slug is made from the title on first save,\nkept unique, and never changed by an edit.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nimport unicodedata\nfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\n\nfrom app import db\n\n\nclass InvalidUpdate(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"The form cannot be saved; the message is shown to the user.\"\"\"\n\n\n_SELECT = (\n    \"SELECT posts.id, title, slug, body, status, created_at, updated_at, \"\n    \"users.name AS author FROM posts JOIN users ON users.id = posts.author_id\"\n)\n\n\ndef slugify(title: str) -> str:\n    ascii_title = unicodedata.normalize(\"NFKD\", title).encode(\"ascii\", \"ignore\").decode()\n    return re.sub(r\"[^a-z0-9]+\", \"-\", ascii_title.lower()).strip(\"-\") or \"update\"\n\n\ndef _unique_slug(conn: sqlite3.Connection, title: str) -> str:\n    base = slugify(title)\n    taken = {row[\"slug\"] for row in conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT slug FROM posts WHERE slug = ? OR slug LIKE ?\", (base, f\"{base}-%\"))}\n    slug, n = base, 2\n    while slug in taken:\n        slug, n = f\"{base}-{n}\", n + 1\n    return slug\n\n\ndef _now() -> str:\n    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec=\"seconds\")\n\n\ndef _clean_title(title: str) -> str:\n    title = title.strip()\n    if not title:\n        raise InvalidUpdate(\"The title cannot be empty.\")\n    return title\n\n\ndef create_update(title: str, body: str, author_id: int) -> int:\n    title = _clean_title(title)\n    now = _now()\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        cursor = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO posts (title, slug, body, status, author_id, created_at, updated_at) \"\n            \"VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'draft', ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (title, _unique_slug(conn, title), body, author_id, now, now),\n        )\n        return cursor.lastrowid\n\n\ndef edit_update(update_id: int, title: str, body: str) -> None:\n    title = _clean_title(title)\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE posts SET title = ?, body = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?\",\n            (title, body, _now(), update_id),\n        )\n\n\ndef get_update(update_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        return conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE posts.id = ?\", (update_id,)).fetchone()\n\n\ndef list_updates() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        return conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} ORDER BY updated_at DESC, posts.id DESC\").fetchall()\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"7d54be4f-6a1d-413d-a9e2-a9a620d534c3","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"a121db57-1bee-4dbb-8856-8744e70c4142","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"6246237e-54ea-46c9-98d8-12c1c8982686","version":"2.1.296","gitBranch":"main"}

__future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import auth, markdown, updates\nfrom   error: str = \"\", status: int = 200):\n    action = f\"/admin/updates/{update['id']}\" if update else \"/admin/updates\"\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/update_edit.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Edit update\" if update else \"New update\", \"user\": user,\n         \"update\": update, \"action\": action, \"form_title\": title, \"body\": body,\n         \"preview\": markdown.render(body), \"error\": error},\n        status_code=status,\n    )\n\n\ndef found(update_id: int):\n    update = updates.get_update(update_id)\n    if update is templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/update_list.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Updates\", \"user\": user, \"updates\": updates.list_updates()},\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"/new\")\ndef new_update(request: Request, user=auth.SIGNED_IN):\n    return editor_page(request, user)\n\n\n@router.post(\"\")\ndef create_update(request: Request, user=auth.SIGNED_IN, _csrf=auth.CSRF,\n                  title: str = Form(\"\"), body: str = Form(\"\"), action: str = Form(\"save\")):\n    if action == \"preview\":\n        return editor_page(request, user, title=title, body=body)\n    try:\n status=400)\n    flash(request, \"success\", \"Draft saved.\")\n    return RedirectResponse(f\"/admin/updates/{update_id}\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{update_id}\")\ndef title=update[\"title\"], body=update[\"body\"])\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{update_id}\")\ndef save_update(request: Request, update_id: int, user=auth.SIGNED_IN, _csrf=auth.CSRF,\n                title: str {"parentUuid":"2566678b-6edf-4142-99e2-6b4a9c05d979","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"d800e3b5-fe00-4637-b632-aebeedb9e0c4","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /Users/maysg/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-plugins-official/mattpocock-skills/1.2.3/skills/engineering/code-review\n\nTwo-axis review of the diff between `HEAD` and a fixed point the user supplies:\n\n- **Standards**: does the code conform to this repo's documented coding standards?\n- **Spec**: does the code faithfully implement the originating issue / spec?\n\nBoth axes run as **parallel sub-agents** so they don't pollute each other's context, then this skill aggregates their findings.\n\nThe issue tracker should have been provided to you. If `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md` is missing, tell the user to run `/setup-matt-pocock-skills`.\n\n## Process\n\n### 1. Pin the fixed point\n\nWhatever the user said is the fixed point (a commit SHA, branch name, tag, `main`, `HEAD~5`, etc.). If they didn't specify one, ask for it.\n\nCapture the diff command once: `git diff <fixed-point>...HEAD` (three-dot, so the comparison is against the merge-base). Also note the list of commits via `git log <fixed-point>..HEAD --oneline`.\n\nBefore going further, confirm the fixed point resolves (`git rev-parse <fixed-point>`) and the diff is non-empty. A bad ref or empty diff should fail here, not inside two parallel sub-agents.\n\n### 2. Identify the spec source\n\nLook for the originating spec, in this order:\n\n1. Issue references in the commit messages (`#123`, `Closes #45`, GitLab `!67`, etc.), fetched via the workflow in `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md`.\n2. A path the user passed as an argument.\n3. A spec file under `docs/`, `specs/`, or `.scratch/` matching the branch name or feature.\n4. If nothing is found, ask the user where the spec is. If they say there isn't one, the **Spec** sub-agent will skip and report \"no spec available\".\n\n### 3. Identify the standards sources\n\nAnything in the repo that documents how code should be written, such as `CODING_STANDARDS.md` or `CONTRIBUTING.md`.\n\nOn top of whatever the repo documents, the Standards axis always carries the **smell baseline** below: a fixed set of Fowler code smells (_Refactoring_, ch.3) that applies even when a repo documents nothing. Two rules bind it:\n\n- **The repo overrides.** A documented repo standard always wins; where it endorses something the baseline would flag, suppress the smell.\n- **Always a judgement call.** Each smell is a labelled heuristic (\"possible Feature Envy\"), never a hard violation. Like any standard here, skip anything tooling already enforces.\n\nEach smell reads *what it is* → *how to fix*; match it against the diff:\n\n- **Mysterious Name**: a function, variable, or type whose name doesn't reveal what it does or holds. → rename it; if no honest name comes, the design's murky.\n- **Duplicated Code**: the same logic shape appears in more than one hunk or file in the change. → extract the shared shape, call it from both.\n- **Feature Envy**: a method that reaches into another object's data more than its own. → move the method onto the data it envies.\n- **Data Clumps**: the same few fields or params keep travelling together (a type wanting to be born). → bundle them into one type, pass that.\n- **Primitive Obsession**: a primitive or string standing in for a domain concept that deserves its own type. → give the concept its own small type.\n- **Repeated Switches**: the same `switch`/`if`-cascade on the same type recurs across the change. → replace with polymorphism, or one map both sites share.\n- **Shotgun Surgery**: one logical change forces scattered edits across many files in the diff. → gather what changes together into one module.\n- **Divergent Change**: one file or module is edited for several unrelated reasons. → split so each module changes for one reason.\n- **Speculative Generality**: abstraction, parameters, or hooks added for needs the spec doesn't have. → delete it; inline back until a real need shows.\n- **Message Chains**: long `a.b().c().d()` navigation the caller shouldn't depend on. → hide the walk behind one method on the first object.\n- **Middle Man**: a class or function that mostly just delegates onward. → cut it, call the real target direct.\n- **Refused Bequest**: a subclass or implementer that ignores or overrides most of what it inherits. → drop the inheritance, use composition.\n\n### 4. Spawn both sub-agents in parallel\n\n**Standards sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The full diff command and commit list.\n- The list of standards-source files you found in step 3, **plus the smell baseline from step 3** pasted in full (the sub-agent has no other access to it).\n- The brief: \"Report, per file/hunk where relevant, (a) every place the diff violates a documented standard: cite the standard (file + the rule); and (b) any baseline smell you spot: name it and quote the hunk. Distinguish hard violations from judgement calls: documented-standard breaches can be hard, but baseline smells are always judgement calls, and a documented repo standard overrides the baseline. Skip anything tooling enforces. Under 400 words.\"\n\n**Spec sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The diff command and commit list.\n- The path or fetched contents of the spec.\n- The brief: \"Report: (a) requirements the spec asked for that are missing or partial; (b) behaviour in the diff that wasn't asked for (scope creep); (c) requirements that look implemented but where the implementation looks wrong. Quote the spec line for each finding. Under 400 words.\"\n\nIf the spec is missing, skip the Spec sub-agent and note this in the final report.\n\n### 5. Aggregate\n\nPresent the two reports under `## Standards` and `## Spec` headings, verbatim or lightly cleaned. Do **not** merge or rerank findings, because the two axes are deliberately separate (see _Why two axes_).\n\nEnd with a one-line summary: total findings per axis, and the worst issue _within each axis_ (if any). Don't pick a single winner across axes: that's the reranking the separation exists to prevent.\n\n## Why two axes\n\nA change can pass one axis and fail the other:\n\n- Code that follows every standard but implements the wrong thing → **Standards pass, Spec fail.**\n- Code that does exactly what the issue asked but breaks the project's conventions → **Spec pass, Standards fail.**\n\nReporting them separately stops one axis from masking the other.\n\n\nARGUMENTS: Review uncommitted working-tree changes since HEAD (477b970) for ticket #3 (T02), spec #1. Ignore notes/usage-ledger.csv and docs/transcripts/ (unrelated). New files: app/markdown.py, app/updates.py, app/routes/updates.py, templates/admin/update_edit.html, templates/admin/update_list.html, tests/test_t02_updates.py, docs/screenshots/t02_update-editor_390px.png."}]},"isMeta":true,"turnCompanion":true,"uuid":"37f0d227-050b-4008-aef6-fbd65474d76f","timestamp":"2026-10-12T22:54:37.116Z","sourceToolUseID":"toolu_011VUf3DavmbeJbwj2TPkszP","session_id":"a121db57-1bee-4dbb-8856-8744e70c4142","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"6246237e-54ea-46c9-98d8-12c1c8982686","version":"2.1.296","gitBranch":"main"}

The report follows:\n  **Standards review: T02 diff (uncommitted, against 477b970)**\n  \n  **(a) Breaches of documented standards**\n  \n  I found no hard violations. These are the documented rules I checked:\n  - **CSRF (CLAUDE.md, SECURITY-CHECKLIST #3):** both POST routes take `auth.CSRF`, and the editor form, the nav logout form and the login form all carry `csrf_token`.\n  - **Sanitize Markdown (CLAUDE.md, checklist #7):** `app/markdown.py` runs `nh3.clean` with allowed URL schemes limited to http, https and mailto. Only that cleaned output reaches `{{ preview | safe }}`.\n  - **Dependencies (CLAUDE.md \"Ask before adding a dependency\"):** `markdown-it-py` and `nh3` are already in `pyproject.toml`, and nothing new was added.\n  - **Vocabulary (CONTEXT.md):** the code uses Update, Draft and Slug, and the `posts` table name is endorsed by the glossary (\"what the CMS stores as a *post*\").\n  - **Relative paths only (CLAUDE.md):** `base.html` and `login.html` switch from relative (`href=\"admin\"`, `action=\"logout\"`) to absolute (`/admin`, `/logout`, `/admin/updates`). The rule covers *published* HTML only, and ADR-001 keeps the admin console off Pages, so this is not a breach. It does reverse T01's convention, and the commit message should say why.\n  \n  **Convention drift (judgement call):** `app/routes/login.py` wires CSRF as `@router.post(..., dependencies=[auth.CSRF])`. `app/routes/updates.py` wires it as an unused parameter `_csrf=auth.CSRF`. Pick one style.\n  \n  **(b) Possible baseline smells (all judgement calls)**\n  \n  - **Possible Duplicated Code** in `app/routes/updates.py`: `create_update` and `save_update` repeat the same steps: `if action == \"preview\": return editor_page(...)`, then `try ... except updates.InvalidUpdate ... status=400`, then `flash` and a 303 redirect. The same goes for `save_new` and `save_edit` in `tests/test_t02_updates.py`, which build the same `data = {\"title\", \"body\", \"csrf_token\", **extra}`.\n  - **Possible Data Clumps:** `title, body` travel together through `editor_page`, `create_update(title, body, author_id)` and `edit_update(update_id, title, body)`. They could be one small form/draft type.\n  - **Possible Mysterious Name:** `found(update_id)` in the routes doesn't say that it fetches the update or raises a 404. Something like `get_or_404` would. In `editor_page`, `title` means the form's title field, but it is passed to the template as `form_title`, while the template's `title` is the page heading. That is two meanings for one word.\n  - **Possible Primitive Obsession:** the status strings `'draft'` and `'published'` are hard-coded in SQL (`VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'draft', ...)`) and in the CHECK constraint. The `flash(request, kind, text)` kind is a free string that doubles as a CSS class. When the publish ticket lands, the status strings will start to spread.\n  - **Possible Speculative Generality (minor):** `<code data-slug=\"{{ update.slug }}\">` exists only so the tests can find the slug.\n  \n  **One rule to keep in view (CONTEXT.md, Editor):** editors \"cannot change published content\", but `edit_update` updates any row whatever its status. Nothing can be published yet, so this isn't a breach today. The publish ticket will need to add that check.\n</agent-message>"}

All 66 tests pass (`uv run pytest -q`). Every acceptance criterion has at least one named test, and nothing is missing.\n  \n  **(a) Missing or partial**\n  - None. Some tests don't really prove what they claim; see (c).\n  \n  **(b) Not asked for (minor, mostly justified)**\n  - **Updates list page** at `/admin/updates` (`templates/admin/update_list.html`). #7 owns \"a filterable content list (by status and by type)\". This list has no filters and gives the nav a target, so it's acceptable. It may be redone in T06.\n  - **Absolute paths in admin templates.** `login.html` (`action=\"/login\"`) and the `base.html` logout/Home links changed from relative to absolute paths. This is needed because relative `logout` breaks under `/admin/updates/...`, and the CLAUDE.md \"relative paths only\" rule applies to published HTML only. It's still a T01 file changed in T02, so the commit message should mention it.\n  - **Small extras:** the 404 for an unknown update, and the `javascript:` link test. Both are harmless.\n  \n  **(c) Implemented, but the test or code looks wrong**\n  1. **Draft-status test is empty.** The spec says \"it is saved as a draft\". In `test_admin_creates_a_draft_with_author_and_timestamps`, `\"Draft\" in page.text` is already satisfied by the flash message \"Draft saved.\" on the same page. It would pass even if the status were wrong. It should check something like `Status: Draft`.\n  2. **Tests check template structure.** The spec says tests assert \"external behavior only... never asserts on internal functions, table layouts, or template structure.\" Several tests do:\n     - `data-slug=\"...\"`, an attribute that seems to exist only for the tests\n     - `class=\"success\"`, `class=\"error\"` and `class=\"preview\"` (splitting the page on it)\n     - `<nav` slicing\n     - a `Created\\s*<time[^>]*>` regex\n     - the viewport `<meta>` string\n  \n     The slug and timestamps could be read from visible text instead.\n  3. **The slug isn't checked across Pages.** The spec says Updates and Pages \"share the same core fields\", and slugs are \"made unique automatically\". `_unique_slug` only looks at `posts`. That's fine for now, but T05 needs to share or extend it.\n  4. **No route lets the admin change a slug.** The spec says \"Only the admin may change a slug.\" The slug is never editable, which meets the \"not editable by editors\" half. Changing slugs belongs to T04/T05, but it isn't in any ticket checklist I saw.\n  5. **`edit_update` doesn't check status.** Any signed-in user can edit published content. The spec says the editor \"may not... edit... published content\". This is T04's work, not a T02 defect, but there's no guard yet.\n  \n  Two checks came out fine:\n  - **CSRF before login:** the login check runs before the CSRF check, so an anonymous POST gets a 303 to login, as the ticket requires.\n  - **390 px fit:** global `box-sizing: border-box` means the full-width textarea doesn't overflow. This agrees with the 390 px screenshot measurement.\n  \n  Files: `/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/updates.py`, `/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/routes/updates.py`, `/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_t02_updates.py`, `/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/templates/admin/update_edit.html`\n</agent-message>"}

That's fine for now, but T05 needs to share or extend it.\n  4. **No route lets the admin change a slug.** The spec says \"Only the admin may change a slug.\" The slug is never editable, which meets the \"not editable by editors\" half. Changing slugs belongs to T04/T05, but it isn't in any ticket checklist I saw.\n  5. **`edit_update` doesn't check status.** Any signed-in user can edit published content. The spec says the editor \"may not... edit... published content\". This is T04's work, not a T02 defect, but there's no guard yet.\n  \n  Two checks came out fine:\n  - **CSRF before login:** the login check runs before the CSRF check, so an anonymous POST gets a 303 to login, as the ticket requires.\n  - **390 px fit:** global `box-sizing: border-box` means the full-width textarea doesn't overflow. This agrees with the 390 px screenshot measurement.\n  \n  Files: `/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/updates.py`, `/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/routes/updates.py`, `/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_t02_updates.py`, `/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/templates/admin/update_edit.html`","handback":true},"promptSource":"system","turnOrigin":"peer","turnPosition":{"promptIndex":1,"turnIndex":3},"queueSkipAttachments":true,"userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"6246237e-54ea-46c9-98d8-12c1c8982686","version":"2.1.296","gitBranch":"main"}

Use a heredoc for multi-line bodies.\n- **Read an issue**: `gh issue view <number> --comments`, filtering comments by `jq` and also fetching labels.\n- **List issues**: `gh issue list --state open --json number,title,body,labels,comments --jq '[.[] | {number, title, body, labels: [.labels[].name], comments: [.comments[].body]}]'` with appropriate `--label` and `--state` filters.\n- **Comment on an issue**: `gh issue comment <number> --body \"...\"`\n- **Apply / remove labels**: `gh issue edit <number> --add-label \"...\"` / `--remove-label \"...\"`\n- **Close**: `gh issue close <number> --comment \"...\"`\n\nInfer the repo from `git remote -v`; `gh` does this automatically when run inside a clone.\n\n## Pull requests as a triage surface\n\n**PRs as a request surface: no.** _(Set to `yes` if this repo treats external PRs as feature requests; `/triage` reads this flag.)_\n\nWhen set to `yes`, PRs run through the same labels and states as issues, using the `gh pr` equivalents:\n\n- **Read a PR**: `gh pr view <number> --comments` and `gh pr diff <number>` for the diff.\n- **List external PRs for triage**: `gh pr list --state open --json number,title,body,labels,author,authorAssociation,comments` then keep only `authorAssociation` of `CONTRIBUTOR`, `FIRST_TIME_CONTRIBUTOR`, or `NONE` (drop `OWNER`/`MEMBER`/`COLLABORATOR`).\n- **Comment / label / close**: `gh pr comment`, `gh pr edit --add-label`/`--remove-label`, `gh pr close`.\n\nGitHub shares one number space across issues and PRs, so a bare `#42` may be either: resolve with `gh pr view 42` and fall back to `gh issue view 42`.\n\n## When a skill says \"publish to the issue tracker\"\n\nCreate a GitHub issue.","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"f9be8fd9-661f-43a9-bc9d-da16a72279b2","timestamp":"2026-10-12T22:56:31.426Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"BASE=unset\n# Issue tracker: GitHub\n\nIssues and specs for this repo live as GitHub issues. The relative-paths rule covers published HTML only, and the admin console never ships (ADR-001). This is noted in the commit. |\n| CSRF wired as a parameter (`_csrf=auth.CSRF`) here, but as `dependencies=[...]` in login.py | **Kept, documented.** FastAPI runs route `dependencies` before the endpoint's own parameters, so that style would give an anonymous POST a 403 instead of the redirect to login this ticket requires. The reason is now in the module docstring. |\n| Possible Mysterious Name: `found()` | **Fixed.** Renamed to `get_or_404()`. |\n| Possible Speculative Generality: `data-slug` attribute that exists only for the tests | **Fixed.** Removed. Tests read the visible \"Slug: …\" text instead. |\n| Possible Duplicated Code: the create and save routes repeat the preview, validate, flash and redirect steps | **Skipped.** Two short routes that differ in the call they make. Revisit when Pages (T05) adds a third. |\n| Possible Data Clumps (`title, body`) and Primitive Obsession (`'draft'`/`'published'` strings) | **Skipped for now.** No status changes exist yet. Revisit in T03/T04, when publish brings in status logic. |\n| `edit_update` doesn't check status, so an editor could edit published content | **Deferred to T04 (#5).** Nothing can be published yet. |\n\n### Spec (every acceptance criterion has a named test)\n\n| Finding | Resolution |\n|---|---|\n| The draft-status assertion `\"Draft\" in page` was already satisfied by the \"Draft saved.\" message, so it proved nothing | **Fixed.** Now asserts `Status: Draft` in the page's visible text. |\n| Tests checked template structure (`data-slug`, `class=\"success\"`/`\"error\"`, a `<time>` regex), against the spec's \"external behaviour only\" rule | **Mostly fixed.** Slug, author, timestamps and success/error messages are now checked as visible text. Kept: splitting on the preview box (the sanitizer test must check that HTML), slicing `<nav>` (the nav is what is under test), and the viewport meta (T01 precedent; the 390 px fit is checked by screenshot). |\n| Unfiltered `/admin/updates` list not asked for | **Kept.** The nav needs a target. Filters belong to T06 (#7). |\n| Slug uniqueness only checks updates, not pages | **Deferred to T05 (#6).** |\n| No way for the admin to change a slug | **Deferred.** This ticket only makes the slug read-only. Admin slug editing isn't in any ticket yet, so it's worth adding to T04 or T05. |\n\nThe 390 px screenshot is at `docs/screenshots/t02_update-editor_390px.png`. {"parentUuid":"e12fbc16-b8e5-4f87-990a-734dc86f0256","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfyAmvn91FG1BcBWeZrFu","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"T02 (#3) is done and committed on `main` as `c4ba125`. It isn't pushed yet, so #3 will only close when you push.\n\n**What it does**\n- Admins can create and edit Updates at `/admin/updates`. New updates are always drafts. Each one stores its author, created and updated timestamps, and a slug.\n- The slug is made from the title when the update is first saved. A second update with the same title gets `-2`, and editing the title doesn't change the slug.\n- The editor has a **Preview** button that shows the rendered Markdown without saving. Script tags, `onerror` attributes and `javascript:` links are stripped out before the preview is shown.\n- A good save shows a one-time success message. An empty title shows an error, saves nothing and keeps what you typed.\n- Every admin screen now has the same navigation: Home, Updates, New update, Log out.\n- Every form carries a CSRF token, and a POST without one is refused with 403. Anonymous visitors are sent to the login page.\n\n**Tests:** the new file `tests/test_t02_updates.py` has 28 tests covering every acceptance criterion, and the full suite passes (66 tests). The project has no typechecker set up, so I couldn't run one.\n\n**Check at 390 px:** in a 390 px frame the editor's page width matched the screen exactly, so there's no sideways scrolling. The screenshot is in `docs/screenshots/t02_update-editor_390px.png`.\n\n**One change to T01's files:** the admin links now use paths starting with `/`. T01's relative `logout` and `admin` links broke on pages under `/admin/updates/`. The relative-paths rule only covers the published site, and the commit message explains this.\n\n**Code review:** I posted the findings and how each was resolved as a comment on #3, as CLAUDE.md asks. The main fix was a test that couldn't fail: its \"is it a draft\" check passed on the \"Draft saved.\" message alone. It now checks the \"Status: Draft\" text, and the tests read visible text rather than page markup. Deferred items:\n- Stopping editors from changing published updates belongs to T04.\n- Making slugs unique across Pages as well as Updates belongs to T05.\n- No ticket yet covers letting the admin change a slug.
